name: qoyod-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your Qoyod accounting company/companies - all 19 API resource types (accounts, products, inventories, customers, vendors, invoices, bills, payments, receipts, journal entries, ...).
long_description: Gives Claude 19 tools that wrap the Qoyod API v2.0 (https://apidoc.qoyod.com/): Accounts, Products, Inventories (+ stock adjustments/transfers), Product Categories, Product Units, Vendors, Purchase Orders, Bills, Bill Payments, Simple Bills, Simple Bill Payments, Debit Notes, Customers, Quotes, Invoices (+ PDF), Invoice Payments, Credit Notes, Receipts and Journal Entries. Each tool supports list / get / create and, where Qoyod allows it, update / delete / allocate. Supports two companies (each Qoyod company has its own API key): every tool takes a `company` parameter. Keys are stored by Claude Desktop and sent only to api.qoyod.com.

company_2_name.title: Company 2 - name (optional)
company_2_name.description: Leave as is if you only have one company.

api_key_2.title: Company 2 - Qoyod API key (optional)
